```{r, load data}
df_list <- list()
results_list <- list()


df_list$task_df <- read_csv("../../data/L122136/cleaned/modelling_data.csv",
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
df_list$factors_df <- read_csv("../../data/L122136/cleaned/composites_data.csv",
                       show_col_types = FALSE)
##
##
# Correct ages recorded with a leading minus sign
##
##

df_list$factors_df$age <- abs(df_list$factors_df$age)

# Exclude not defined gender due to small n
df_list$factors_df[(df_list$factors_df$gender != 'Male') & (df_list$factors_df$gender != 'Female'), c("gender")] <- NA

data <- inner_join(
  df_list$task_df,
  df_list$factors_df,
  by = "subject_id"
)

data$Caught <- as.numeric(data$Caught)
data$Noise_Condition <- as.factor(data$Noise_Condition)
data$gender <- as.factor(data$gender)

print(paste("N all =", length(unique(data$subject_id))))
print(paste("N ctrl =", length(unique(na.omit(data) %>% pull(subject_id)))))
```

```{r}
rad_factors <- c("FA_DOG", "FA_AUTH")
```

# 1. Mean inference & extremism

## Prepare data

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    mean_inf = circDiff_abs(Mean, Bucket.Position) * -1,
    mean_angle_diff = circDiff_abs(Mean, Angle),
    mean_angle_diff_sc = ave(mean_angle_diff, subject_id, FUN=scale)
  )
```


```{r}
frml_string <- "mean_inf ~ predictor + Noise_Condition + (Noise_Condition | subject_id)"

# a) no control variables
results_list$mean_inf <- run_models(
  formula_string=frml_string,
  predictors=rad_factors,
  data=data,
  z_scale = TRUE,
  control = FALSE,
  sensitivity = TRUE)

results_list$mean_inf$results
results_list$mean_inf$sample_info

# b) with control variables
results_list$mean_inf_ctrl <- run_models(
  formula_string=frml_string,
  predictors=rad_factors,
  data=data,
  z_scale = TRUE,
  control = TRUE,
  sensitivity = TRUE)

results_list$mean_inf_ctrl$results
results_list$mean_inf_ctrl$sample_info
```

## 2.1 Calibration-Bias

### Prepare data

```{r}
bucket_size <- 36
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    Std = if_else(Noise_Condition == "Low_Noise",12,21),
    # Signed circular distance between bucket centre and latent mean
    delta = ((Bucket.Position - Mean + 180) %% 360) - 180,

    # Theoretical probability of catching the particle
    P_catch = round(
      pnorm((delta + bucket_size / 2) / Std) -
      pnorm((delta - bucket_size / 2) / Std),
      4
      ),
    calibration = conf/100 - P_catch,
    overconf = as.numeric(calibration > 0)
  ) %>% select(
    -c(Std,delta,P_catch)
  )
```

```{r}
frml_string <- "calibration ~ predictor + (1 | subject_id)"

# a) no control variables
results_list$calibration <- run_models(
  formula_string=frml_string,
```

# 3. Learning rate

## Prepare data

```{r}
# processing Seow & Gillan proc:
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    lr = ifelse(pe == 0, NA, action / pe)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(lr)) %>%
  filter(lr < quantile(lr, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))

data %>% pull(lr) %>% hist()

# cutoff for log transform from ...
q1 <- quantile(data$lr, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
q3 <- quantile(data$lr, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
c <- q1^2 / q3

data <- data %>% mutate(lr_log = log(lr + c))

data %>% pull(lr_log) %>% hist()

```

```{r}
frml_string <- "lr_log ~ predictor + Noise_Condition + (Noise_Condition | subject_id)"
    
# a) no control variables
```

# 4. HGF & Extremism

## Prepare data

```{r}
# Load mean person-level HGF output
df_list$hgf_df <- read_csv("../../data/L122136/cleaned/HGF_Model_output.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(subject_id = ID)

# Load trial-wise HGF output
df_list$hgf_trial_df <- read_csv("../../data/L122136/cleaned/Ehgf_taskData2.csv",show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(subject_id = as.character(subject_id))

# Join with data
data <- inner_join(
  data,
  df_list$hgf_df,
  by = c("subject_id")
  ) %>% left_join(
    df_list$hgf_trial_df %>%
      select(c("subject_id","ranked_PE",starts_with(c("mu","lr","sa")))),
    by = c("subject_id","ranked_PE")
  )

# Prepare between-subjects data
bw_data <- inner_join(
  bw_data,
  df_list$hgf_df,
  by = c("subject_id")
  )

hgf_params <- c("om", "om2", "oma")
comp_measures <- c("mux1", "mux2", "mua", "lr1", "lr2", "sax1", "sax2", "saa", "Caught")
```

# 6. Political Orientation Associations

```{r}
library(patchwork)

# Participant-level data
df_list$orientation_df <- df_list$factors_df %>%
  select(FA_PO, FA_DOG, FA_AUTH) %>%
  drop_na()

make_orientation_plot <- function(data, outcome, y_label, show_x = FALSE) {

  ggplot(
    data,
    aes(
      x = FA_PO,
      y = .data[[outcome]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      colour = "#001A8D",
      size = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "lm",
      formula = y ~ x + I(x^2),
      se = FALSE,
      colour = "#001A8D",
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    labs(
      x = if (show_x) {
        "Left \u2190 Political orientation \u2192 Right"
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 8, 5, 5)
    )
}

p_dog <- make_orientation_plot(
  data = df_list$orientation_df,
  outcome = "FA_DOG",
  y_label = "Dogmatic Intolerance"
)

p_aut <- make_orientation_plot(
  data = df_list$orientation_df,
  outcome = "FA_AUTH",
  y_label = "Authoritarianism"
)


orientation_plot <- (
  p_dog /
  p_aut
) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = list(c("B", "C"))
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    )
  )

orientation_plot
```

# 7. Main Figure

```{r main-results-figure, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=8.0, dpi=300, out.width="100%", fig.align="center", dev="ragg_png"}

fig_w <- 6.5
fig_h <- 7.4

col_att <- c(
  "Dogmatic intolerance" = "#245A76",
  "Authoritarianism"     = "#BC633F"
)
att_levels  <- names(col_att)
full_sample <- "A: Full sample"

ink   <- "#263341"
muted <- "#5B6875"
rule  <- "#D5DBE1"
band  <- "#F4F6F8"

# Typographic helpers: proper minus sign, APA-style p
fmt_beta <- function(x) gsub("-", "\u2212", sprintf("%+.3f", x))
fmt_p    <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "< .001",
                               paste0("= ", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p))))

# One shared base theme so both panels look like one figure
theme_fig <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      text             = element_text(colour = ink),
      axis.text        = element_text(colour = muted),
      axis.title       = element_text(colour = ink),
      axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin      = margin(4, 8, 4, 4)
    )
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# A | BEHAVIOURAL SIGNATURES
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
measure_levels <- c("Metacognitive sensitivity", "Overconfidence (calibration)",
                    "Confidence", "Learning rate", "Mean inference")   # bottom -> top

behavioural <- bind_rows(
  results_list$mean_inf_ctrl$results %>% mutate(Measure = "Mean inference"),
  results_list$lr_ctrl$results       %>% mutate(Measure = "Learning rate"),
  results_list$overconf_ctrl$results %>% mutate(Measure = "Overconfidence (calibration)"),
  results_list$metacog_ctrl$results  %>%
    mutate(Measure = if_else(grepl("pe_rank_sc", Predictor, fixed = TRUE),
                             "Metacognitive sensitivity", "Confidence"))
) %>%
  filter(Sample == full_sample, grepl("FA_DOG|FA_AUTH", Predictor)) %>%
  mutate(
    Attitude = factor(
      if_else(grepl("FA_DOG", Predictor, fixed = TRUE),
              "Dogmatic intolerance", "Authoritarianism"),
      levels = att_levels
    ),
    Measure = factor(Measure, levels = measure_levels),
    ypos    = as.numeric(Measure) +
      if_else(Attitude == "Dogmatic intolerance", 0.17, -0.17)
  )

stopifnot(nrow(behavioural) == 10L)

# Zebra bands instead of lines running through the middle of each pair
bands <- tibble(ymin = c(0.5, 2.5, 4.5), ymax = c(1.5, 3.5, 5.5))

p_behaviour <- ggplot(behavioural, aes(y = ypos, colour = Attitude)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = bands, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    fill = band
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "#8996A2",
             linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = CI_low, xend = CI_high, yend = ypos),
               linewidth = 0.9, lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(aes(x = Coefficient), size = 2.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:5,
    labels = c("Metacognitive\nsensitivity", "Overconfidence\n(calibration)",
               "Confidence", "Learning rate", "Mean inference"),
    limits = c(0.5, 5.5), expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = breaks_pretty(6),
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01, style_negative = "minus"),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.04)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_att, breaks = att_levels) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(
    ncol = 1, override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.9, size = 2.6)
  )) +
  labs(x = "\u03B2 (95% CI)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme_fig() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = rule, linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(colour = ink, size = 9.5,
                                      lineheight = 0.95, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),

    # Legend inside the (empty) top-right of the panel
    legend.position        = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.985, 0.985),
    legend.justification   = c(1, 1),
    legend.background      = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = rule,
                                          linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.margin          = margin(5, 8, 5, 6),
    legend.key.width       = unit(14, "pt"),
    legend.key.height      = unit(12, "pt"),
    legend.text            = element_text(colour = ink, size = 9),

    # Space between panel A and panel B
    plot.margin = margin(4, 8, 26, 4)
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# B | ENVIRONMENTAL VOLATILITY  (participant-level, no new models)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
volatility_points <- bw_data %>%
  select(subject_id, om2, FA_DOG, FA_AUTH) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(FA_DOG, FA_AUTH), names_to = "Factor", values_to = "attitude") %>%
  filter(is.finite(om2), is.finite(attitude)) %>%
  mutate(Attitude = factor(
    recode(Factor, FA_DOG = "Dogmatic intolerance", FA_AUTH = "Authoritarianism"),
    levels = att_levels
  )) %>%
  group_by(Attitude) %>%
  mutate(theta_z    = as.numeric(scale(om2)),
         attitude_z = as.numeric(scale(attitude))) %>%
  ungroup()

get_theta <- function(name, label) {
  results_list[[name]]$results %>%
    filter(Sample == full_sample, Predictor == "om2") %>%
    mutate(Attitude = label)
}

# CHANGED: Both lines and annotations use adjusted models
theta_adjusted <- bind_rows(
  get_theta("hgf_dog_ctrl",  "Dogmatic intolerance"),
  get_theta("hgf_auth_ctrl", "Authoritarianism")
) %>% mutate(Attitude = factor(Attitude, levels = att_levels))

theta_lines <- theta_adjusted

stopifnot(nrow(theta_lines) == 2L, nrow(theta_adjusted) == 2L)

# Annotation: adjusted estimates only
theta_lab <- theta_adjusted %>%
  mutate(
    Attitude = factor(Attitude, levels = att_levels),
    label    = sprintf("beta == '%s' * ',' ~ italic(p) ~ '%s'",
                       fmt_beta(Coefficient), fmt_p(p))
  )

# Symmetric axes, same on both facets
x_lim <- ceiling(max(abs(volatility_points$theta_z)))
y_lim <- ceiling(max(abs(volatility_points$attitude_z)))

p_volatility <- ggplot(volatility_points,
                       aes(x = theta_z, y = attitude_z, colour = Attitude)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = rule, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = rule, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.35, shape = 16) +
  geom_abline(data = theta_lines,
              aes(slope = Coefficient, intercept = 0, colour = Attitude),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 1, lineend = "round") +
  geom_text(data = theta_lab,
            aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.35,
            size = 2.9, lineheight = 1.05, colour = ink, parse = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Attitude, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_att, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_number(style_negative = "minus")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(style_negative = "minus")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-x_lim, x_lim), ylim = c(-y_lim, y_lim)) +
  labs(
    x = "Environmental volatility (\u03D1)",
    y = "Radical attitude"
  ) +
  theme_fig() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "#EEF1F4", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.spacing.x  = unit(14, "pt"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", colour = ink,
                                    size = rel(1.05), hjust = 0,
                                    margin = margin(b = 4)),
    axis.title.x     = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),
    axis.title.y     = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6))
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# COMBINE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
main_results_figure <- (
  (p_behaviour / p_volatility) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.15)) +
    plot_annotation(
      tag_levels = "A",
      theme = theme(
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        plot.margin     = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
      )
    )
) & theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, colour = ink))

main_results_figure
 
```
